Fantastic first time pass this morning at Nelson Driving Test Centre for Jess Tattersall! 🎉

An incredible drive with Jess passing with only 3️⃣ driver faults 😀

Well done for keeping those nerves under control! I told you that you had the potential to pass! And I told you this a couple of months ago! 😂 

You've become an even better driver though for waiting until you was ready! 🎉😀🚗🚦🛑

Good luck with with finding a car! 😀
